# Variable `HOST_AS_ARCH`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies architecture-specific assembler flags.

Default initialization for HOST_AS_ARCH varies depending on what is being built:

- TARGET_AS_ARCH when building for the target

- BUILD_AS_ARCH when building for the build host (i.e. `-native`)

- SDK_AS_ARCH when building for an SDK (i.e. `nativesdk-`)

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-HOST_AS_ARCH)
